summary: Banner Corporation filed an 8-K announcing its board authorized a stock repurchase program of up to 1.7 million shares, approximately 5% of issued and outstanding common stock. The repurchase will occur through open market purchases, with timing and extent dependent on market conditions. CEO Mark Grescovich cited attractive valuation as rationale. No price, premium, or expiration date provided. The program is a return-of-capital initiative, not a tender offer. Watch for execution pace and market impact.
